items.title: A power of the ideal of a closed subspace annihilates a coherent sheaf exactly when the support is contained in that subspace
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes the vanishing of a power of the ideal of a closed subspace acting on a coherent sheaf by containment of the support of the sheaf in that subspace (statement lines 2338-2346). The proof passes to an affine Noetherian scheme etale over the space, notes that both the annihilation condition and the support condition are local for that cover, and concludes by the corresponding statement for schemes. The reduction to schemes and the locality check are the substance, so the claim is H2.
